items.description: AI mutation tools for Systems: add create_system, update_system, delete_system to src/services/ai/aiTools.ts (AI_DATABASE_TOOLS definitions + executeAiTool cases + MUTATION_TOOLS + describeToolMutation/describeToolMutationWithContext + getFriendlyToolLabel in aiOrchestratorLoop). Use createSystem/updateSystem/deleteSystem from src/db/repositories/systemRepo.ts. Tools must return JSON string errors instead of throwing. Preserve invariants: LOGICAL_GROUP has no SSH/repo, subsystem parent must be LOGICAL_GROUP, code unique.

AI tools for Mermaid diagrams: add query_diagrams (read), create_diagram, update_diagram in aiTools. Diagram is a Note with type 'diagram' whose body is mermaid source. Use createNote/updateNote. query_diagrams filters by tag/title/entity and returns id/title/tags/updatedAt WITHOUT full body by default, with an includeBody parameter. create_diagram and update_diagram go into MUTATION_TOOLS; query_diagrams does not.

Configurable system type list: SystemType is a hardcoded union in src/types/models.ts, z.enum in src/validation/schemas.ts, options hardcoded in SystemModal.tsx, SystemTable.tsx SYSTEM_TYPE_CONFIG, SystemDetailView.tsx SYSTEM_TYPE_TAG, TargetSystemsSelector.tsx TYPE_TAG_COLORS/TYPE_LABELS, SystemCatalogView.tsx filter, backupSchemas.ts, and query_systems enum. Make types user-extensible at runtime: store {value,label,color} list in the settings table under its own key with defaults fallback, read through useLiveQuery so UI updates. Keep the LOGICAL_GROUP-is-parent invariant. SystemModal uses AutoComplete allowing a new type value which gets persisted. Add add/edit/delete management UI in SettingsView. Validation accepts /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$/ instead of a fixed enum; backup import accepts types beyond defaults.
